description: Electro-Mechanical Technician job role is designed with various modules to equip learners with the necessary skills for diverse industrial applications. This qualification ultimately helps learners in the following ways:To become proficient in the design and manufacturing of control panels, industrial automation, and machine maintenance.Design and construct a Mechatronics subsystem, write a PLC program to automate the system, and test its function for prescribed outputs.To secure employment opportunities across a wide range of sectors, including Engineering/Manufacturing industries.
